promise: Scammed? RecoverAI turns one payment screenshot into every report, freeze request and complaint you need — in your language, inside your country's deadlines.
uploadHint: Payment screenshot, scammer messages, or a voice note.
whyNoPay: Why we never ask for money
whyNoPayText: Real agencies, banks and RecoverAI never charge you to get your money back. Anyone asking for a fee, tax or deposit to 'release' or 'recover' funds is trying to scam you again.
confirmDelete: Delete this case and its evidence permanently?
retry: Something went wrong. Please try again.
disclaimer: RecoverAI prepares drafts and reminders. It is not legal advice, does not handle money, and never charges victims. Official agencies and your bank make all decisions.
sandboxNote: Sandbox — test only. Nothing is sent to a real bank.
sandboxLocked: Locked: demo evidence or already sent
confirmCheck: I confirm these details are correct and this is my own account (or I am authorised)
undone: Not sent. Nothing left your phone.
withdrawText: Your bank stops using the details you shared and they are hidden from its analysts.
withdrawHold: If a hold was already placed, the bank decides whether to release it.
voiceUnclear: I couldn't hear that clearly — please try again or type your message
micBlocked: Microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser's site settings, or type instead
micInsecure: Voice needs the secure (https) app link
micUnsupported: Voice notes are not supported in this browser — please type instead
voiceTooShort: That recording was too short — hold on a little longer, or type your message
inAppBrowser: For voice notes, open this link in Chrome or Safari (not inside WhatsApp or Gmail).
micHelpAndroid: Android: Chrome → Site settings → Microphone; also Settings → Apps → Chrome → Permissions.
heroTitle: Lost money to a scam? The first hour matters.
heroSub: RecoverAI helps you report, freeze and follow up — in your language, inside your country's deadlines.
hotlineNote: Free national helpline. Calling within the first hour gives the best chance to freeze the money.
how1: Tell us what happened — type or speak, add a payment screenshot.
how2: Get your urgent steps and deadlines, in order.
how3: Ready-to-send complaints, bank letters and an evidence pack.
safetyLine: RecoverAI will never ask you for money, OTPs or passwords.
passwordRule: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
termsAgree: I agree to the Terms and Privacy notice.
termsPurpose: Purpose: helping you report and recover from fraud (DPDP Act 2023 / PDPA).
errPassword: Password needs at least 8 characters, a letter and a number.
errTerms: Please accept the Terms and Privacy notice.
errBadLogin: Phone number or password is incorrect
errExists: An account with this number already exists — please sign in.
haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
phoneNotVerified: Your number is not verified by SMS yet (demo).
profileWhy: Your bank and the police need these to act on your complaint. Only you and RecoverAI's server can see them.
deleteAccountConfirm: Delete your account, profile and all your cases? This cannot be undone.
profileCardTitle: A few details for your complaint
profileCardHint: Check them and tap Save. I won't save anything for you.
deleteReauth: Enter your password to finish deleting your login.
deleteReauthFailed: Your cases and profile were deleted, but the login could not be removed. Log in again and repeat Delete account.
roleBank: I work at a bank (fraud team)
roleBankHint: Bank staff accounts need admin approval before they see any data.
